note: Provisional. No source reviewed says tokenization takes data out of scope of the CBN circular (PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004, 15 June 2026), and the CBN FAQs are pending. Edit this file, not code, when guidance lands. This pack is audit evidence, not a statement of compliance.

questions.question: Where is payment transaction data stored and managed, including backups and disaster recovery?
questions.rule: CBN circular s.2, effective 1 January 2027 (scope as read by Credence Law and Pavestones)

questions.question: Where are encryption keys held, and who administers them?
questions.rule: CBN "managed in Nigeria": key management and access administration (Pavestones)

questions.question: Who can access it, and from where?
questions.rule: CBN "managed in Nigeria"; offshore support arrangements (Credence Law)

questions.question: Are logs, audit trails, support copies or analytics exports replicated offshore?
questions.rule: CBN circular as read by Credence Law

questions.question: What still flows to foreign vendors, and on what ground?
questions.rule: NDPA Part VIII and GAID 2025 Schedule 5: adequacy, an approved instrument, or section 43. The NDPC had issued no instrument as of May 2026

questions.question: Can you prove the access log was not altered?
Can you answer a person's access or deletion request?
How fast would you notice misuse?
questions.rule: NDPA breach notification duties. Confirm the current timing with your DPCO

questions.question: Who changed security settings, and who approved?
Where else do identifiers sit?
questions.rule: Data mapping for the NDPC compliance audit (GAID: within 15 months of starting business, then annually)
